messages:
maria_infra: Quick heads-up: small maintenance tonight on EU-edge pool (racks b2,b3). Window 23:15-01:00 UTC. Scope: NIC link-training toggle + BMC minor firmware on a subset (6 nodes per rack). We'll do rolling cordon -> drain -> reboot. After each rack bring-up we'll run cache warm and perf probes.
arun_sre: Impact? any dedicated racks affected?
maria_infra: No dedicated reservations on b2/b3. Expect ~10% transient capacity dip per rack during drain/backfill for ~12-18min. We have warm spare capacity in us-west to absorb tails.
casey_ops: I can move low-priority preemptibles to us-west. I'll run backfill 10m before each rack cordon. Command: ```./ops backfill --to-region us-west1 --label preemptible --window 00:20```
jenna_prod: Preparing status blurb. Will post 25m before start with INC-EU-1749.
luis_neteng: Preflight: I'll test link training toggle on one host first. Procedure: ```ethtool -s eth0 autoneg off; ethtool -s eth0 speed 10000 duplex full;``` then flash. If iperf shows >1% retransmits or perf probe shows p95 +100ms, abort.
deploy-bot: Maintenance ticket INC-EU-1749 created. Reminder set 20m before.
arun_sre: Routing note: enable 'eu-edge-fallback' during the window so new requests can be routed to us-west warm pool. I'll prepare the config flip playbook.
maria_infra: Canary plan: pick two nodes in b2. Reboot sequentially, run synthetic load for the top 3 models and the embed endpoint. Pass criteria: p95 delta <70ms AND error rate <0.4% AND no packet loss >0.8%.
casey_ops: Backfill dry-run shows 31 jobs would move; estimated extra 6 GPUs in us-west, cost est ~ $85 for the window. Logs: ```backfill: moved 31 jobs; freed 5 gpus in eu-edge```
jenna_prod: Exec notify drafted: "Maintenance INC-EU-1749 tonight 23:15-01:00 UTC; rolling reboots on EU edge racks b2,b3. Brief capacity dips possible; automatic fallback to us-west enabled." Posting to #customer-notify 20m prior.
luis_neteng: Starting single-host flash test on b2-node05 now. Will monitor link stats and kernel dmesg.
casey_ops: Running cordon for b2 nodes in 8m per plan. Command: ```kubectl cordon b2-node{01..06}; ./ops drain --grace 90 --selectors gpu=true```
maria_infra: Reminder: after reboot run cache-warm: ```./ops cache-warm --pool eu-edge --concurrency 6 --models core,small,large``` aim to reduce cold-token tails.
support-bot: Support rota notified. Pager escalation set to @oncall-signal.
luis_neteng: Test host b2-node05 after flash: iperf retransmits 0.3%, perf-probe p95 +12ms, dmesg clear. Looks good.
arun_sre: Flipping eu-edge-fallback at start + enabling traffic drain window.
casey_ops: cordon/drain done for b2-node01-06. Rebooting. Backfill freed 5 GPUs.
deploy-bot: Canary-check: synthetic load p95 +85ms on model 'core-latest' and error rate 0.1%. Marking warning. @maria_infra
maria_infra: Hmm p95 +85ms exceeds our 70ms threshold. Abort further reboots. Rolling back reboots for b2 and uncordoning remaining nodes. Reverting eu-edge-fallback to baseline.
jenna_prod: Posting pause notice to status page: "We paused the maintenance after a canary p95 spike on core-latest. Investigating; new ETA TBD."
casey_ops: Reverting nodes now, uncordon in progress.
luis_neteng: Early signals point to link-training mode interaction with specific NIC driver on that host. I'll rollback NIC flash on node05 and run extended iperf and rx drop checks.
arun_sre: I'll collect kernel logs and perf traces for the canary timeframe. Creating a follow-up incident for deeper triage if needed.
support-bot: No customer escalations so far. Support monitoring enabled.
casey_ops: Firmware rollback on b2-node05 complete; perf-probe back to baseline. Recommend 30m soak then re-run single-host canary.
maria_infra: Agreed. We'll reschedule continuation after 30m soak. New tentative resume 00:10 UTC. Jenna, please update the exec and customer notes.
jenna_prod: Done. Execs notified and status updated.
deploy-bot: INC-EU-1749 updated: paused after canary p95 violation; rollback completed on canary host.
arun_sre: Action item: add a preflight driver compatibility check into the playbook to avoid node-specific regressions.
maria_infra: Thanks team. Keeping thread open. We'll confirm restart 10m prior to resume. :white_check_mark:
